harness.note: #66 defines the benchmark and is not implemented. This is a raw record of one zenchron_planned execution in the shape #66 asks results to identify themselves by. There is no corpus, no direct_agent baseline and no zenchron_explicit baseline, so no ratio is computed and none may be inferred from this file.

case.acceptance: docs/troubleshooting.md gives a copy-pasteable command that provisions the dependency cache with the digest-pinned assurance image, and explains why verification cannot fill the cache itself

controller.note: a plain `go build` of zenchron/64-engineering-planner, the branch under review

cost.reason: both providers are subscription CLIs and reported no cost; unknown is not zero

measured.provider_invocations_note: Attributed to the plan by the reconciler: the two stage runs. The PLANNING invocation that produced the plan is a third real provider call and is not in this number - it happens before the plan exists to attribute it to. Read the total as 3 when comparing against a mode that includes its own planning.

unmeasured: planning_invocation_wall_seconds - the planner invocation is not separately instrumented; the plan's first journal event is the proposal

supervision_minutes - operator attention was not wall-clock measured. It was not zero: the exercise that reached this run cost 4 pre-execution refusals, 3 defect fixes in the branch under review, 1 restart and 1 self-inflicted disruption. Only the successful plan's 1 approval and 0 interventions are counted above.
direct_agent and zenchron_explicit baselines for this case - not run

outcome.ci: go: SUCCESS on the exact head
outcome.independent_review: 4 findings raised; the reviewer explicitly refused to certify gofmt/go vet/go test because its sandbox refused to run them, and said so rather than claiming a pass

interpretation.note: One observation, one trivial documentation case, no baseline. It shows the planned path executes end to end and that the independence obligation produced a genuinely independent review. It shows nothing about leverage, and this record must not be read as a positive leverage result.
